changes: One loading screen: a VORTEX loading ring around the play button
Source players’ own loading circles are hidden from the first moment
All-new look: glossy glass design across the whole app
Home: cinematic featured shows with synopsis, genres and scores, plus a daily Spotlight
Full titles on every card, star ratings, and redesigned Top 10
Show pages: big artwork header, synopsis panel, source cards and new episode list
New floating navigation dock, collapsing Explore header and Library stats
Includes the 1.1.6 MegaPlay fixes
MegaPlay’s own loading spinner no longer shows; VORTEX shows the only loading screen
Fixed MegaPlay episodes sometimes stuck at 00:00 with “Playback stopped” while the video played
Android: MegaPlay now uses VORTEX controls only; its own controls no longer show
Subtitles sit at the bottom of the picture instead of the bottom of the screen
The player retries by itself if a source doesn’t respond on the first load
One player: MegaPlay and Anikoto no longer show their own controls, captions or skip buttons under VORTEX
VORTEX subtitles for every source, with timing adjustment and size and background settings
Continue watching on Home and in Library, and Resume right where you stopped
Episode progress bars, watched marks, go to episode, newest first, and mark as watched
Faster: episode lists open in about 2 seconds the first time and instantly after
Plays the best quality a source offers by default
New Playback settings: preferred sub or dub, autoplay next, skip intros and credits, remembered speed
Optional 18+ titles setting (off by default, asks your age first)
Redesigned search, source picker with source icons, and Sources and connection screen
Works anywhere now: on any Wi-Fi or mobile data, not just at home
A new VORTEX player for every source: play, seek, ±10s, volume, subtitles, speed, quality, Fit/Fill and full screen
MegaPlay and Anikoto play on Windows too, with skip intro and resume where you left off
MegaPlay finds shows it used to miss, like Attack on Titan Season 2, and long shows list every episode
Episode titles are correct for later seasons
Keyboard shortcuts on Windows: Space, arrows, M, F, C, N and Esc

Episodes play again on Anime Paradise
A cleaner player: big play button, skip back and forward 10 seconds, and a seek bar with times
Turn your phone sideways for full-screen landscape

Video keeps its real shape instead of being squished
A brand new app icon
If a source is down, the player now tells you which one and why
Your quote now floats beside your picture in a bubble. Tap it to read the whole thing
Smoother and lighter: the moving background uses less than half the power it did, and long episode lists use less memory
A new look: glass buttons and panels over moving gradient backgrounds
15 themes, including Onyx black, Graphite grey and Pearl white

Profiles: picture, banner, bio, pronouns, quote and status. Drag an image in or tap to pick one
